newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on Thai news.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on Thai news.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Thursday, supported by news that the Thai government had bought 14,800 tonnes of RSS3 rubber, traders said.
The newly listed benchmark October contract ended at 137.4 yen after opening at 135.1 yen. Other prices ranged from 2.9 yen to 3.6 yen per kg higher.

Prices opened mostly firmer in a technical correction after recent sharp price falls. "Short-covering gathered force in the afternoon as the Thai news provided psychological support to the market," one trader said.
